results.question: I'm running my first Session Zero next week. Any tips?

answer.text: [1] Start Strong: Running a Session Zero That Sets Up Your Whole Campaign recommends treating Session Zero as a real session, with full attendance and ninety minutes to two hours. Session Zero Checklist (Downloadable PDF) [2] suggests creating characters as a group, ensuring party roles are covered, and tying each character to the setting with a hook the GM can use. Session Zero Checklist (Downloadable PDF) [2] advises connecting the party by deciding how they already know each other, giving them a shared goal or reason to adventure together, and ending with a one-line summary of the campaign's promise. Session Zero Checklist (Downloadable PDF) [2] provides a checklist for building characters together, defining house rules, and connecting the party. Session Zero to Hero: A New Dungeon Master's Guide [3] explains that Session Zero is a preparatory meeting before the first actual session, where you and your players align on tone, expectations, safety, and the kind of story you want to tell together. Session Zero Checklist – The Ultimate Game Master Companion (Digital PDF) [4] offers a digital PDF checklist that can be downloaded immediately after purchase, printed, shared with players, or loaded into a digital DM toolkit.
